topic: Finish-phase fixes for the features that just shipped: #71, #74, #66, #72 — one run, four small issues, all in internal/finish, internal/cli/archive.go, cmd_done.go, the two host prompts and the design doc.

last_digest.summary: BuildShipped` now derives a waived wave's commit tasks from the close record (unfiltered by status) then the dispatch event, `waveTimings` emits one span per dispatch with the last close winning, and both are pinned by an eighth golden built through `BuildRetroInputs`/`BuildShipped` plus three focused tests.

BuildPR` now renders an `## Issues` section between `## Goals` and `## Run`, parsing bare `#N`, `https?://…/issues/N` and `owner/repo#N` from the topic with hand-checked boundaries, de-duplicated in topic order with the closing keyword repeated per reference, covered by a 15-row table including all six boundary negatives.

Reworded the push invariant in commands/takt.md, anchored its exception clause in crossHostInvariants, added internal/hosts/skill.go's ordered substitution profile with RenderCopilotSkill, taught hostgen to generate and check hosts/copilot/skills/takt/SKILL.md from the prompt and manifest version, regenerated the skill, and covered all of it with tests in internal/hosts, internal/tools/hostgen and internal/prompt.

Restated §7.5 step 5's archive-step guarantee in both places as a no-write-after-commit claim (naming the untracked session sidecar as the sole post-commit write) and cast the retro-done and re-taken archive commits as separate later `takt` invocations; all verify commands pass.
